h: Angry residents of Area 1, Abuja, seen destroying posters of President Tinubu and Wike
p: Residents of Area 1 in Abuja have reportedly been seen tearing down and destroying campaign posters bearing the images of President Bola Tinubu and FCT Minister Nyesom Wike. What triggered the anger is not yet clear.
body: Residents of Area 1 in Abuja have reportedly been seen tearing down and destroying posters bearing the images of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and FCT Minister Nyesom Wike.

Footage from the scene shows a group of young men pulling down large posters mounted on wooden frames by the roadside, ripping them apart and carrying away the torn pieces as onlookers gather near market stalls.
The incident has drawn attention, with many asking what could have triggered such an angry reaction.

The exact reason behind the destruction of the posters remains unclear, and no group has claimed responsibility. Even so, it has sparked discussion about public frustration and the relationship between political leaders and ordinary Nigerians as the 2027 elections approach.
What do you think could have pushed these residents to take such action?
